# Surfer Element

> Surfer Element is a booking service in Tamraght, Morocco, representing
> three independent surf houses — SurfsHUB Tamraght, Cactus Surf & Skate
> House and Hakuna Matata Guest House. One multilingual site to compare the
> three houses, see real guest-review scores, and book with a locked-in
> price and a single deposit, instead of visiting three separate sites.

Surfer Element is paid by the three houses listed on this site and
represents only them — it is not an independent directory of every Tamraght
surf camp. All comparisons on this site are between these three houses only.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://surferelement.com/): overview and the fastest way to the fit check or the full comparison
- [Compare the three houses](https://surferelement.com/compare/): the full side-by-side comparison, alphabetical by default
- [Fit check](https://surferelement.com/fit-check/): a short quiz matching a traveller to the house that fits them
- [Price lock](https://surferelement.com/price-lock/): how the fixed, locked-in price works
- [SurfsHUB Tamraght](https://surferelement.com/houses/surfshub-tamraght/)
- [Cactus Surf & Skate House](https://surferelement.com/houses/cactus-surf-skate-house/)
- [Hakuna Matata Guest House](https://surferelement.com/houses/hakuna-matata/)
- [About / how it works](https://surferelement.com/about/)
- [FAQ](https://surferelement.com/faq/)
- [Contact](https://surferelement.com/contact/)
- [Tamraght guide](https://surferelement.com/guide/): seasonal and logistics content (spots, months, getting to Tamraght)

This file is maintained by `website-publisher` and updated as new guide
content is published.
